title: Board View column header shows grip, avatar, name, pin and count as designed
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at location "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919" (on another site: the location named in the test run).
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide with the zoom at 100%, and the design pictures "DC-10-board-column-headers-light-1440.png" and "DC-10-board-pinned-light-1440.png" attached to this case are open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and the rank numbers in the pictures are sample data.
  • Technicians "ZZAUTOTEST C590119 Lea" (with a profile photo), "ZZAUTOTEST C590119 Max" (no photo), "ZZAUTOTEST C590119 Nia" and "ZZAUTOTEST C590119 Oli" are active at this location, and no technician is pinned in your Board View.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST C590119 Column Header" has Approved work orders "C590119-U1" led by "ZZAUTOTEST C590119 Lea" and "C590119-U2" led by "ZZAUTOTEST C590119 Max", and an Estimate, unit "C590119-U3", with no lead technician.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Board View" shown, "Search" holding "ZZAUTOTEST C590119 Column Header", no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off, density "Regular".
  • If any record named above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at the "Unassigned" column header from left to right.
  2. Look at "ZZAUTOTEST C590119 Max"'s column header from left to right.
  3. Look at the avatar in "ZZAUTOTEST C590119 Lea"'s column header.
  4. Click the pin in "ZZAUTOTEST C590119 Max"'s column header.
  5. Look at the pin in "ZZAUTOTEST C590119 Max"'s column header.
  6. Click the pin in "ZZAUTOTEST C590119 Lea"'s column header.
  7. Click the pin in "ZZAUTOTEST C590119 Nia"'s column header.
  8. Hover the pin in "ZZAUTOTEST C590119 Oli"'s column header.
  9. Click the pins of "ZZAUTOTEST C590119 Max", "ZZAUTOTEST C590119 Lea" and "ZZAUTOTEST C590119 Nia" to unpin them.
custom_expected:
Step 1: a round light-grey avatar with a grey outline person icon, the word "Unassigned" in dark semibold text, a short grey divider, a clipboard outline icon and the count. No grip and no pin, as in the picture.

Step 2: the six-dot grip, a light-grey circle with the initials in dark grey (a little darker than in the design picture, not a solid blue circle with white initials), the name in dark slate semibold text, a grey outline pin, a short divider, the clipboard icon and the count.

Step 3: the avatar is the technician's round photo.

Step 4: "ZZAUTOTEST C590119 Max"'s column moves to just after "Unassigned".

Step 5: the pin is a pin with a slash through it, in blue, as in the pinned picture.

Step 6: "ZZAUTOTEST C590119 Lea" is pinned too.

Step 7: "ZZAUTOTEST C590119 Nia" is pinned too; three technicians are pinned.

Step 8: the pins on the unpinned columns look faded and the hover text reads "You can pin up to 3 technicians."

Step 9: every technician column header shows the grey outline pin again.

AUTOMATION: READY
